description_en: Disassociates shared resources or principals from a resource share
description_zh: 为共享单元移除共享资源或资源使用者
name: DisassociateResourceShare

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource share
parameters.name: resource_share_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the shared resource.

You can disassociate up to five shared resources in a single request.

The `Resources.N.ResourceId` and `Resources.N.ResourceType` parameters must be specified in pairs
fields.help_zh:
共享资源ID。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多移除5个共享资源。

Resources.N.ResourceId与Resources.N.ResourceType成对出现，需要同时设置
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the shared resource.

You can disassociate up to five shared resources in a single request.

For a list of supported resource types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html.

The `Resources.N.ResourceId` and `Resources.N.ResourceType` parameters must be specified in pairs
fields.help_zh:
共享资源类型。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多移除5个共享资源。

支持共享的资源类型，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html。

Resources.N.ResourceId与Resources.N.ResourceType成对出现，需要同时设置
fields.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: A list of shared resources to disassociate from the resource share
parameters.name: resources

parameters.help_en: A list of principals to disassociate from the resource share
parameters.name: targets

parameters.help_en:
A list of the Alibaba Cloud Resource Names (ARNs) of the shared resources.

You can disassociate up to five shared resources in a single request
parameters.help_zh:
共享资源ARN列表。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多移除5个共享资源
parameters.name: resource_arns

parameters.help_en:
The owner of the resource share. Valid values:

`Self` (default): The resource share is owned by the current account. Use this value when a resource owner disassociates shared resources or principals from a resource share within a Resource Directory.

`OtherAccounts`: The resource share is owned by another account. Use this value when a principal leaves a resource share that was created by an account outside your Resource Directory
parameters.help_zh:
共享单元归属者。取值：

Self（默认值）：共享单元归属于当前账号。适用于资源目录内共享时，资源所有者移除共享资源或资源使用者场景。
OtherAccounts：共享单元归属于其他账号。适用于资源目录外共享时，资源使用者主动退出共享单元场景
parameters.name: resource_owner

ResourceShareAssociations.description_en: The associations of shared resources or principals with the resource share
ResourceShareAssociations.description_zh: 共享单元关联的共享资源或资源使用者信息

items.description_en: An association of a shared resource or principal with the resource share
items.description_zh: 共享单元关联的共享资源或资源使用者信息

AssociationStatus.description_en:
The status of the association. Valid values:

`Associating`: The entity is being associated.

`Associated`: The entity is associated.

`Failed`: The association failed.

`Disassociating`: The entity is being disassociated.

`Disassociated`: The entity is disassociated.

The system automatically deletes records in the `Failed` and `Disassociated` states within 48 to 96 hours
AssociationStatus.description_zh:
关联状态。取值：

Associating：关联中。
Associated：已关联。
Failed：关联失败。
Disassociating：分离中。
Disassociated：已分离。

`Failed`和`Disassociated`状态的记录，会在48~96小时内被系统自动删除

AssociationStatusMessage.description_en: The reason why the disassociation failed

AssociationType.description_en:
The association type. Valid values:

`Resource`: The entity is a resource.

`Target`: The entity is a principal
AssociationType.description_zh:
关联类型。取值：

Resource：资源。
Target：资源使用者

CreateTime.description_en:
The time the association was created. The meaning varies based on the `AssociationType`:

If the `AssociationType` is `Resource`, this is the time the resource was associated.

If the `AssociationType` is `Target`, this is the time the principal was associated
CreateTime.description_zh:
取消关联的时间。存在以下两种情况：

当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数为移除资源的时间。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数为移除资源使用者的时间

EntityId.description_en:
The ID of the entity. Its value varies based on the `AssociationType`:

If `AssociationType` is `Resource`, the value of this parameter is the resource ID.

If the `AssociationType` is `Target`, this is the ID of the Resource Directory, Folder, or Member
EntityId.description_zh:
关联实体ID。取值：

当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数为资源ID。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数为资源目录ID、资源夹ID或成员ID

EntityType.description_en:
The type of the entity. Valid values:

If the entity is a resource, this is the resource type. For more information, see [Services that work with Resource Sharing]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）.

If the entity is a principal, the value is `Account`
EntityType.description_zh:
关联实体类型。取值：

当关联实体为资源时，该参数为资源类型。更多信息，请参见[支持资源共享的云服务]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）。
当关联实体为资源使用者时，该参数为Account

ResourceArn.description_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the shared resource.

This parameter is returned only when `AssociationType` is `Resource`
ResourceArn.description_zh:
关联资源ARN。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数不可用

ResourceShareId.description_en: The ID of the resource share

ResourceShareName.description_en: The name of the resource share

TargetProperty.description_en:
The properties of the principal, such as the time period for resource sharing.

This parameter is returned only when the principal is an Alibaba Cloud service
TargetProperty.description_zh:
资源使用者属性。例如：资源共享的时间段。
仅当资源使用者为阿里云服务时返回该参数

UpdateTime.description_en:
The time the association was last updated. For this operation, this indicates the time of disassociation. The meaning varies based on the `AssociationType`:

If the `AssociationType` is `Resource`, this is the time the resource was disassociated.

If the `AssociationType` is `Target`, this is the time the principal was disassociated
UpdateTime.description_zh:
取消关联的更新时间。存在以下两种情况：

当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数为移除资源的更新时间。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数为移除资源使用者的更新时间
